description: Check a SemQL query for errors and get completion suggestions before running it. Use this when a query is unfamiliar or a search returned an invalid_request error.

cursor.description: Byte offset into the query to suggest completions for. Defaults to the end of the query.

query.description: SemQL query to check. May be partial: completions are suggested for the position given by cursor.

name: noetive_lint
